name: Qwen Multi-Angle (re-angle a still)
description: Re-shoot an existing image of the same subject from a new camera angle. Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 + multi-angle LoRA holds identity, clothing, and lighting while changing the camera viewpoint. Produces a sibling of the source still at a different angle.

image.description: Source image filename or Studio output path to re-angle

prompt.description: Camera-angle spec only (the <sks> trigger is prepended automatically; do NOT pass a character/scene prompt here). Format: '<azimuth> view <elevation> shot <distance>'. Azimuth: front | front-right quarter | right side | back-right quarter | back | back-left quarter | left side | front-left quarter. Elevation: low-angle | eye-level | elevated | high-angle. Distance: wide shot | medium shot | close-up. Example: 'front-right quarter view eye-level shot medium shot'

examples.prompt: left side view eye-level shot medium shot

notes: Output resolution auto-derives from the source via FluxKontextImageScale. Models live only on the 12GB PC node — always submit with provider=local-pc. Runs 4-step Lightning (steps/cfg/sampler baked in). Do not attach a character; pass only the angle spec as prompt.
